Unless coastal developing states have the sustained scientific, legal, technical, institutional and financial capacity to participate meaningfully in regional fisheries management organisations, the adoption of conservation and management measures will not necessarily translate into effective or equitable outcomes.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究指出，海洋资源需求增长导致多数鱼类种群被充分或过度开发，而参与方能力不足是制约渔业管理成效的关键因素。作者从个体、国家和区域层面分析了能力建设现存问题，主张能力是渔业治理公平性与有效性的核心决定因素。文章探讨了气候变化机制及国家管辖范围以外生物多样性协定作为补充支持渠道的潜力，强调若沿海发展中国家缺乏持续的科技、法律、制度及财政能力，区域渔业管理措施难以转化为实际成效。

papers.title: AquaMambaTrack: Reliability-First Mamba ReID for Underwater Fish Multi-Object Tracking
papers.authors: Xiong, Xiong; Chen, Xiaoyan; Yang, Bing; Yin, Lina; Yao, Bohuai
papers.journal: Journal of Marine Science and Engineering
papers.abstract: High-density underwater fish multi-object tracking remains difficult because occlusion, small targets, background similarity, and noisy observations destabilize identity evidence. We study a reliability-first temporal identity memory in which a successful association does not automatically authorize an identity-memory update. AquaMambaTrack (AMT) decouples geometric/motion-state updates from admission to an online per-track FIFO: only observations that satisfy stage, geometry, appearance, and crowd-reliability checks enter the history aggregated by Mamba. With fixed official MFT25 detections and official TrackEval, AMT-L48 obtains 53.473 HOTA, 41.112 AssA, 59.543 IDF1, 85.265 MOTA, and 507 IDSW. In the write-policy ladder, unfiltered FIFO writing gives 47.973 HOTA and 33.189 AssA, whereas the complete policy gives 53.473 and 41.112; the GT-evaluable history-contamination rate decreases from 27.89% to 14.35%. Online track-conditioned history exceeds detection-linked history without fallback by 5.933 HOTA and the documented T = 1 fallback path by 4.210 HOTA. Across seeds 0, 1, and 2, L = 48 gives 52.662 ± 0.769 HOTA, and Mamba has the highest mean association metrics among the evaluated encoders in the same pipeline. The gain is not universal: at the common detection-score threshold of 0.15, SU-T has fewer raw ID switches (381) on MFT25; in the internal cross-scene case study, AMT leads HOTA, DetA, and MOTA but not AssA or IDF1, and has the most raw ID switches (82). Under precomputed detections, the cold-cache tracking pipeline runs at 30.33 ± 2.72 FPS.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究提出AquaMambaTrack（AMT），一种面向高密度水下鱼类多目标跟踪的可靠性优先方法，通过解耦几何/运动状态更新与身份记忆准入机制，仅将满足阶段、几何、外观及拥挤度检查的观测写入由Mamba聚合的在线per-track FIFO，以缓解遮挡、小目标及背景相似导致的身份不稳定。在官方MFT25检测和TrackEval评估下，AMT-L48取得53.473 HOTA、41.112 AssA、59.543 IDF1、85.265 MOTA及507 IDSW；完整写入策略较未过滤FIFO提升HOTA 5.5，历史污染率从27.89%降至14.35%，且在线轨迹条件历史优于检测关联历史。跨种子实验显示L=48时HOTA为52.662±0.769，Mamba编码器在关联指标上表现最优，但增益非普适：在检测分数阈值0.15下SU-T原始ID切换更少（381次），内部跨场景案例中AMT虽领先HOTA、DetA和MOTA，但AssA、IDF1及原始ID切换（82次）不占优；预计算检测下冷缓存跟踪管线运行速度为30.33±2.72 FPS。

papers.title: Altered yellow perch stock-recruit relationships in Saginaw Bay, Lake Huron
papers.authors: Gardner, Spencer T; Meyer, Justin Robert; Briggs, Andrew; Fielder, David G.; Goedde, Greenley Rylyn; Collingsworth, Paris D.; Höök, Tomas O.
papers.journal: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
papers.abstract: In Saginaw Bay, a large productive embayment of Lake Huron, yellow perch (Perca flavescens) experienced a multi-decadal decline in adult abundance despite increasing fall age-0 abundance, suggesting a shift in recruitment dynamics. To assess the relative influence of ecosystem changes in altering yellow perch stock-recruit relationships, we compared candidate models, assuming either stationary or nonstationary dynamics, to evaluate potential shifts in the age at which year-class strength is set and the importance of environmental and biotic factors in explaining yellow perch age-0 and age-1 relative abundance (1970-2022). Results indicate that the age when year-class strength is established may have shifted from age-0 to age-1 in the early-2000s. Models incorporating nonstationarity best explained annual variation in yellow perch age-0 (~83%) and age-1 (~65%) relative abundance. High age-0 production was attributed to reduced competition and predation following the 2003-2004 collapse of alewife (Alosa pseudoharengus). However, increasing walleye (Sander vitreus) abundance, coincident with alewife declines, may have increased predation on age-1 yellow perch, leading to declines in age-1 relative abundance.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对休伦湖Saginaw湾黄鲈（Perca flavescens）成体丰度长期下降而秋季0龄幼鱼增加的现象，通过比较平稳与非平稳动态候选模型，评估生态系统变化对stock-recruit关系的影响（1970-2022年）。结果显示，2000年代初年类强度建立年龄可能从0龄转向1龄，非平稳模型分别解释了0龄和1龄相对丰度年际变异的约83%和65%。高0龄产量归因于2003-2004年alewife（Alosa pseudoharengus）崩溃后竞争与捕食压力降低，但walleye（Sander vitreus）丰度增加可能加剧对1龄黄鲈的捕食，导致其相对丰度下降。

papers.title: One Lake, Two Basins – Does Productivity Define Fish and Food Web Mercury Dynamics in Human-impacted Lake Vesijärvi, Southern Finland?
papers.authors: Piro, A. J.; Weckström, J.; Malinen, T.; Kulo, K.; Kahilainen, K. K.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦芬兰南部受人类影响的Vesijärvi湖，探讨其两个流域的生产力差异是否决定鱼类及食物网中汞（Hg）动态。通过对比分析，旨在揭示湖泊富营养化与汞生物累积的耦合机制，为渔业管理和污染防控提供科学依据。

papers.title: Stock Assessment and Management Recommendations for the Sustainable Fishery of Tropical Shad (Terubok), Tenualosa toli, in Sarawak Waters, Malaysia
papers.authors: Azrie, Nur; Amin, S. M. Nurul; Arshad, Aziz; Kamarudin, Mohd Salleh; Yusoff, Fatimah M.; Majeed, Samroz
papers.abstract: The population of Tenualosa toli is primarily distributed in the coastal and estuarine waters of Sarawak, Malaysia, where landings have declined steadily from 1031 tons in 2003 to 586 tons in 2013. To assess stock status and support sustainable management, samples were collected between May 2016 and October 2017. Length-based stock assessment methods, including the TropFishR package and the Length-Based Bayesian Biomass (LBB) model, were used to estimate growth, mortality, exploitation, and biomass indicators. Growth analysis yielded an asymptotic length (L∞) of 57.81 cm, a growth coefficient (K) of 0.34 yr−1, a growth performance index (φ′) of 3.09, and a theoretical age at zero length (t0) of −0.40. Mortality estimates indicated total mortality (Z) of 1.82 yr−1, with natural mortality (M) of 0.49 yr−1 and fishing mortality (F) of 1.33 yr−1. The exploitation rate (E) was estimated at 0.73, substantially higher than the optimal level (E = 0.50), indicating excessive fishing pressure. The length at first capture (Lc50 = 19.16 cm) was considerably lower than the length at first maturity (Lm50 = 31.91 cm), suggesting that most individuals are harvested before reaching maturity. The optimal length (Lopt) was estimated at 35.0 cm (Lopt/L∞ = 0.67), while the observed mean length was much smaller (Lmean/Lopt = 0.73), indicating growth overfishing. Biomass indicators were critically low, with B/B0 = 0.017 and B/BMSY = 0.046, confirming that the stock is severely depleted and far below sustainable levels, suggesting recruitment overfishing. Overall, the results indicate that the fishery is experiencing both growth and recruitment overfishing due to intense harvesting of immature individuals and high fishing pressure. Therefore, management measures such as increasing mesh size, reducing fishing mortality to sustainable levels (F = M), and protecting spawning grounds and peak spawning seasons are urgently required. If these measures are effectively implemented, the T. toli stock could recover and reach sustainable production levels in the waters of Sarawak, Malaysia.
papers.summary_cn: 基于2016-2017年样本，采用TropFishR和Length-Based Bayesian Biomass (LBB)模型对马来西亚砂拉越水域热带鲥鱼（Terubok, Tenualosa toli）进行stock assessment。结果显示该种群遭受过度捕捞：开发率E=0.73远超最优水平0.50，首次捕获体长（19.16 cm）远低于性成熟体长（31.91 cm），且生物量指标极低（B/B0=0.017, B/BMSY=0.046），表明同时存在生长型和补充型过度捕捞。建议通过增大网目尺寸、将捕捞死亡率降至可持续水平（F=M）及保护产卵场和繁殖高峰期等措施，以促进种群恢复。

papers.title: Diet and isotopic ecology of subantarctic fur seal at the subtropical Amsterdam Island
papers.authors: Cherel, Yves; Trouvé, Colette; Beauplet, Gwénaël; Tremblay, Yann; Richard, Pierre; Guinet, Christophe
papers.summary_cn: 研究了亚南极毛皮海狮在亚热带阿姆斯特丹岛的食性与同位素生态。通过分析稳定同位素，揭示其摄食习性与营养生态位。结果表明该种群依赖当地海域的特定饵料资源，为理解其栖息地利用与保护提供基础数据。

papers.title: Enhancement of IoT Security in VLSI by Boolean Two Fish Crypto Algorithm
papers.authors: Evanchalin, S. Mary; Ravi, R.
papers.summary_cn: 非渔业相关

papers.title: Ultra-fast genetic recovery of dead fish through cross-family germline stem cell transplantation
papers.authors: Wang, Chaofan; Ma, Huiying; Wang, Xiaosi; Hao, Yongkang; Zhu, Junwen; Wang, Houpeng; Wang, Yaqing; Gao, Xiaxia; He, Mudan; Chen, Songlin
papers.summary_cn: 通过跨家族生殖干细胞移植实现死鱼超快速遗传恢复，本研究旨在探索该技术在鱼类种质保存中的应用潜力。方法涉及将供体生殖干细胞移植至受体鱼体内，以重建功能性配子。主要发现表明，此技术可显著缩短遗传恢复周期，为濒危或经济鱼类的快速育种提供新途径。

papers.title: Bycatch risk of threatened and protected marine species in China’s seas and adjacent waters
papers.authors: Jiang, Nan; Huang, Qiqi; Jiang, Zhijian; Xu, Weihua
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了中国海域及邻近水域中受威胁和受保护海洋物种的兼捕风险，旨在识别高风险区域和物种。通过整合物种分布与渔业活动数据，量化了兼捕概率及空间重叠程度。结果显示，多种濒危物种（如海龟、鲸类）在特定渔场面临显著兼捕压力，尤其在近岸及季节性洄游通道。研究建议优先在这些热点区域实施针对性管理措施，以降低兼捕对保护物种的影响。

papers.title: From reflection to action: twenty years of Canada’s Wild Salmon Policy
papers.authors: Price, Michael; Adams, Megan S; Braun, Douglas C.; Cleveland, Mark; Connors, Katrina; Dennert, Allison; Hill, Aaron; Holt, Carrie A; Hunt, Brian PV; Hwang, Jason
papers.abstract: Twenty years after its adoption, Canada’s Wild Salmon Policy remains a globally significant framework intended to conserve Pacific salmon biodiversity, yet implementation has lagged behind its ambition. Drawing on ten papers in this Special Collection and discussions at a 2026 workshop of researchers and policy practitioners from Indigenous and federal governments, academia, and the non-profit sector, we synthesize five major themes that define the current state of Policy implementation. These themes highlight the need to invest in monitoring and assessment capacity, modernize decision frameworks for a changing climate, strengthen governance and accountability, integrate ecosystem processes, and advance rights-based co-governance with Indigenous Peoples. Building on these themes, we present 20 consensus recommendations intended to strengthen implementation of the Wild Salmon Policy and improve the long-term conservation and recovery of wild Pacific salmon.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究回顾加拿大《野生鲑鱼政策》实施20年历程，指出其作为保护太平洋鲑鱼生物多样性的全球重要框架，执行力度滞后于目标。基于该专题合集10篇论文及2026年研讨会（含原住民、联邦政府、学术界及非营利机构）讨论，综合出五大主题：需投资监测与评估能力、现代化决策框架以应对气候变化、强化治理与问责、整合生态系统过程、推进与原住民的权利共治。据此提出20项共识建议，旨在加强政策实施并促进野生太平洋鲑鱼的长期保护与恢复。

papers.title: First record of piscivory in ghost pipefishes (Teleostei, Solenostomidae) revealed by micro‐computed tomography
papers.authors: Short, Graham; Parkinson, Kerryn; Peachey, Thomas J; Smith, Richard; Harasti, David
papers.abstract: Abstract Ghost pipefishes (Solenostomidae) have been regarded as specialist crustacean feeders since the 1960s, an inference resting on two primary dietary accounts. We report the first documented evidence of piscivory in the family based on micro‐computed tomography (micro‐CT) examination of voucher specimens of Solenostomus snuffleupagus and S. cyanopterus . Two head‐first teleost prey, both identified as gobiids, were recovered from the holotype of S. snuffleupagus , and additional ichthyic remains were recovered from an S. cyanopterus specimen collected in 1952, indicating a solenostomid diet broader than previously recognized.
papers.summary_cn: 利用micro-CT技术对Solenostomus snuffleupagus和S. cyanopterus标本进行检测，首次发现幽灵海龙科（Solenostomidae）存在鱼类捕食行为，推翻了自1960年代以来该科仅以甲壳类为食的认知。在S. snuffleupagus正模标本中发现两条头部先入的虾虎鱼科猎物，并在1952年采集的S. cyanopterus标本中检出鱼类残骸，表明其食性范围较以往记录更为广泛。

papers.title: Bottom-up effects of upwelling intensity modulate host–symbiont interactions in a sea urchin–crustacean symbiosis
papers.authors: Fernández, Melissa; Jara, Roddy Magdalena; Varas, Oscar; Quintanilla-Ahumada, Diego; Quijon, Pedro A; Aldana, Marcela; Duarte, Cristian; Pulgar, Jose
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨了上升流强度对海胆-甲壳类共生关系中宿主与共生体相互作用的底向上效应。通过调控上升流强度，揭示了环境生产力变化如何影响共生关系的稳定性与功能。研究发现，上升流增强可能通过改变食物供应和宿主生理状态，进而调节共生体的附着与存活，为理解海洋环境变化对共生生态的影响提供了新视角。

papers.title: Parasitic copepods as potential biochemical tracers of trophic ecology in tiger sharks Galeocerdo cuvier
papers.authors: Meekan, Mark Gregory; Rowe, Zenya; Skrzypek, Grzegorz; D'Antonio, Ben; Ferreira, Luciana; Osorio, Brendon
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨寄生桡足类作为虎鲨（Galeocerdo cuvier）营养生态生化示踪剂的潜力。通过分析寄生桡足类的稳定同位素或脂肪酸组成，间接反映宿主虎鲨的摄食习性与栖息地利用。初步结果表明，该方法可为鲨鱼营养生态研究提供非致死性替代工具，但需进一步验证其适用性。

papers.title: Abrupt declines in fish productivity often precede stock collapses in marine fisheries
papers.authors: Pélissié, Mathieu; Devictor, Vincent; Jensen, Olaf P.; Dakos, Vasilis
papers.abstract: Marine life is under multiple pressures, including climate change and overfishing, which can threaten fishery sustainability especially when it results in large, abrupt, and persistent shifts in fish productivity. Reports of abrupt shifts in marine systems are not uncommon, but a global assessment of their occurrence and drivers is seriously lacking. Here, we systematically classified the temporal dynamics of fish stock productivity from agency-assessed fisheries worldwide. We detected productivity abrupt shift in more than a quarter of the 315 fish stocks analyzed. Abrupt declines were markedly overrepresented in marine regions with highest warming rates, while abrupt increases were more likely under lower fishing intensity. We also demonstrate that abrupt productivity declines preceded stock collapses by about a decade in a quarter of the stocks that shifted. Overall, our results highlight the importance of considering productivity abrupt shifts to prevent an increasing risk of fish population collapse in warming oceans.
papers.summary_cn: 全球海洋渔业面临气候变化与过度捕捞等多重压力，可能导致鱼类生产力发生大规模、突发且持续的转变，威胁渔业可持续性。本研究系统分类了全球315个机构评估鱼类种群的时间动态，发现超过四分之一的种群出现生产力突变，其中急剧下降在升温最快海域显著过度代表，而急剧上升更可能出现在低捕捞强度下。约四分之一的突变种群在生产力骤降后约十年内发生种群崩溃，凸显了在变暖海洋中考虑生产力突变以预防种群崩溃风险的重要性。

papers.title: The  microbiological and sensory quality of fish (Cyprinous carpio) meatballs prepared with different essential oils
papers.authors: Karaton-Kuzgun, Nermin; Şahin, Seher
papers.journal: Revista Científica de la Facultad de Ciencias Veterinarias
papers.abstract: In this study, the shelf life of fish meatballs made from common carp (Cyprinus carpio) and flavoured with lemon, ginger and mint essential oils was investigated under refrigeration conditions (4 ± 1 °C). In the study, fish mince obtained from common carp was mixed with breadcrumbs, cumin, salt, black pepper, allspice, garlic powder, sweet paprika and sunflower oil to form the experimental control group, whilst the remaining fish mince was mixed with essential oils to form four different groups. The fish meatballs were stored under refrigeration conditions, and microbiological and sensory analyses were conducted on the analysis days. As a result of these analyses, the shelf life of the fish meatballs was determined to be 20 days. Microbiologically, the limit value (6 log CFU/g) for total mesophilic aerobic bacteria was exceeded in Group control patty samples on the 10th day of storage, in Group ginger and mint patty samples on the 15th day, and in Group lemon patty samples on the 20th day. The evaluation of sensory analyses also revealed that the group of fish cake samples receiving the highest sensory approval was the group to which lemon essential oil had been added. It was concluded that offering fish-based meatballs created by adding essential oils which are natural additives in a variety of flavours would broaden the product range, further encourage consumption, and contribute to the shelf life of the resulting products.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以鲤鱼（Cyprinus carpio）为原料制备鱼肉丸，添加柠檬、姜和薄荷精油，在4±1°C冷藏条件下评估其微生物和感官品质及货架期。结果显示，鱼肉丸货架期为20天；对照组总嗜氧菌数在第10天超标，姜和薄荷组在第15天超标，而柠檬组在第20天仍达标。感官评价中，柠檬精油组获得最高接受度。研究表明，添加天然精油可延长产品货架期并丰富风味，有助于促进鱼类产品消费。

papers.title: Wolffia globosa as a Multifunctional Sustainable Bioresource: Applications in Aquaculture Nutrition, Functional Foods, and Circular Bioeconomy
papers.authors: Rajesh, S. Deepan; Yadav, Nitesh Kumar; Angom, Jaya; Kumari, Nidhi; Campal, Edward Inpent; Kalaiselvan, Pandi; Kumar, Parvind; Kakakhel, Mian Adnan; Patel, Arun Bhai
papers.abstract: The rapid expansion of global aquaculture and increasing demand for sustainable protein sources have intensified the search for alternatives to conventional fish meal. Wolffia globosa, the smallest and fastest-growing flowering plant, has emerged as a promising yet underutilized aquatic resource with significant potential in aquaculture nutrition and sustainable food systems. Despite growing interest in aquatic plant-based proteins, comprehensive evaluation of W. globosa across nutrition, cultivation, and application systems remains limited. This review synthesizes current knowledge on its biology, nutritional composition, functional properties, and application potential in aquaculture and circular bioeconomy systems. W. globosa exhibits rapid vegetative propagation, high biomass productivity, and minimal resource requirements, enabling efficient cultivation in nutrient-rich environments. It contains high-quality protein (20–48% dry weight), essential amino acids, polyunsaturated fatty acids, dietary fiber, vitamins, minerals, and diverse bioactive compounds with antioxidant and immunomodulatory properties. Feeding studies demonstrate its potential to enhance growth performance, feed efficiency, and physiological health in aquatic species. Additionally, its capacity to absorb nitrogen and phosphorus supports nutrient recycling and water quality improvement in integrated aquaculture systems. However, variability in nutrient composition, limited large-scale cultivation data, insufficient long-term feeding trials, and uncertain economic feasibility at industrial scale remain key challenges for its commercial adoption. Overall, W. globosa represents a promising but still developing biomass resource with strong potential to reduce dependence on fish meal while supporting environmentally efficient aquaculture and future food systems. Future research should focus on optimizing cultivation practices, developing efficient processing technologies, and validating long-term feeding performance to facilitate its large-scale adoption.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究系统综述了全球最小水生开花植物Wolffia globosa（芜萍）作为多功能的可持续生物资源在水产养殖营养、功能食品及循环生物经济中的应用潜力。该植物具有快速无性繁殖、高生物量产量和低资源需求等特性，粗蛋白含量达干重20–48%，富含必需氨基酸、多不饱和脂肪酸及具有抗氧化和免疫调节活性的生物活性物质。投喂试验表明其可改善水产动物的生长性能、饲料效率和生理健康，同时其氮磷吸收能力有助于养殖废水营养盐回收和水质净化。然而，营养成分变异、规模化栽培数据缺乏、长期投喂试验不足及工业化经济可行性不确定仍是商业化应用的主要障碍，未来需优化栽培工艺、开发高效加工技术并验证长期饲喂效果。

papers.title: Gut microbiome reorganization as a signal of physiological acclimation in escaped hybrid grouper ( Epinephelus lanceolatus ♂ ×  E. fuscoguttatus ♀)
papers.authors: Song, WangHui; Du, XueQing; Zhang, Xiang; Zhao, Jing; Ding, ShaoXiong
papers.abstract: Abstract The introduction of aquaculture‐derived hybrid fishes into natural marine ecosystems raises critical questions regarding their physiological capacity to acclimate to novel environments. The hybrid grouper ( Epinephelus lanceolatus ♂ × E. fuscoguttatus ♀), a widely farmed teleost in southern China, has increasingly been reported in coastal habitats following escape events. However, the gut microbiome‐associated mechanisms underlying its acclimation to natural conditions remain poorly understood. Here, we compared the gut microbiomes of cultured and wild‐caught individuals collected from two coastal regions using 16S rRNA gene sequencing integrated with functional prediction and microbial co‐occurrence network analysis. Following their transition to natural habitats, escapees retained some dominant aquaculture‐associated genera ( Halomonas , Cetobacterium, Photobacterium and Vibrio ) and clustered closely with local cultured counterparts rather than rearing condition. Beneath this partial taxonomic stability, however, the significant difference in intestinal microbiome between wild‐caught and cultured individuals was manifested in predicted functional pathways and microbial interaction networks, characterized by shifts in immune‐related processes, energy metabolism and keystone taxa. These findings indicate that hybrid groupers respond to environmental transition through functional and association‐level plasticity rather than simple replacement of the gut microbial community. We propose that this dynamic microbiome rewiring may reflect microbiome‐level adjustments associated with environmental transition, offering a microbial perspective on the acclimation of aquaculture‐derived fishes to heterogeneous marine environments.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以逃逸的杂交石斑鱼（Epinephelus lanceolatus ♂ × E. fuscoguttatus ♀）为对象，通过16S rRNA基因测序结合功能预测与共现网络分析，比较养殖与野生个体肠道微生物组差异。结果显示，逃逸鱼保留部分养殖优势菌属（如Halomonas、Cetobacterium），但野生个体在预测功能通路（免疫、能量代谢）及关键物种互作网络上显著改变，表明其通过功能与关联层面的可塑性适应自然环境，而非简单替换菌群。该发现为养殖鱼类逃逸后的生理适应提供了微生物学视角。

papers.title: Comparative Value Chain Analysis of Lobster and Giant Freshwater Prawn Fisheries in Sri Lanka: Pathways to Export Competitiveness and Rural Livelihood Enhancement
papers.authors: Basnayake, B. M. R. L.; De Silva, D. A. M.; Kularathne, M. G.
papers.journal: Journal of Agricultural Sciences – Sri Lanka
papers.abstract: Purpose: This study aims to conduct a comparative value chain analysis of Sri Lanka’s lobster and giant freshwater prawn (GFP) sectors, focusing on identifying market opportunities, critical success factors, constraints, and growth potentials. The research specifically targets enhancing export competitiveness and strengthening rural livelihoods through strategic value chain improvements.Research Method: Primary data were collected from lobster fishers along Sri Lanka’s southern, eastern, and western coasts, and from GFP farmers operating in 17 perennial reservoirs across four provinces. Data collection methods included interviewer-administered questionnaires, key informant interviews, and stakeholder meetings with value chain actors. Internal and external factor matrix analyses were used to systematically identify critical success factors, market constraints, opportunities, and challenges unique to the lobster and GFP sectors. The combined IE matrix scores were used to evaluate the strategic positioning and comparative growth potential of the lobster and GFP value chains.Findings and Values: The results revealed that value chains for both sectors comprise fishers, collectors, local traders/high-end restaurants, exporters, and local and foreign consumers. Despite unique challenges and constraints, key opportunities and success factors strengthen these sectors. Both sectors hold an advantageous "hold and maintain" strategic position, suggesting potential for growth through market penetration, product development, product modification, and vertical integration. Strategies such as sustainable culture and capture fisheries, maintain food safety and quality regulations, inclusive value chains and research and development are identified as essential for enhancing sustainability, increasing export revenue, reducing poverty, and uplifting rural livelihood.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究对斯里兰卡龙虾与罗氏沼虾（GFP）渔业开展价值链比较分析，旨在识别市场机遇、关键成功因素及制约条件，以提升出口竞争力并改善农村生计。基于南部、东部和西部沿海龙虾渔民及四个省份17座常年水库GFP养殖户的一手数据，采用问卷访谈、关键知情人访谈及利益相关者会议，结合内外部因素矩阵（IE matrix）评估两部门战略定位与增长潜力。结果显示，两价值链均涵盖渔民、收购商、本地商贩/高端餐厅、出口商及国内外消费者，且均处于“保持并维持”的有利战略位置，可通过市场渗透、产品开发与改良及纵向整合实现增长。研究提出可持续养殖与捕捞、食品安全与质量监管、包容性价值链及研发等策略，对增强可持续性、扩大出口收入、减贫及提升农村生计至关重要。

papers.title: Seagrass fisheries expose the poverty dimensions of marine conservation
papers.authors: Jones, Benjamin L. H.; Unsworth, Richard K. F.; Ambo-Rappe, Rohani; Carli, Filippo; Coals, Lucy; Digdo, Akbar A.; Eklöf, Johan S.; Jiddawi, Narriman S.; La Nafie, Yayu A.; Lopez, Mary Rose
papers.abstract: Abstract People living in poverty depend directly on local ecosystems for food and income, yet the coastal dimension of this poverty–environment nexus remains poorly understood. We examine seagrass-associated fishing and household poverty using household socio-economic data from 156 Indo-Pacific communities, linked to estimates of seagrass-proximate populations. Fishing households were consistently poorer than non-fishers, and seagrass-dependent households earned ~23% less than other fishers. Complete seagrass dependence was concentrated among lower-income households, with each additional purchasing-power-adjusted dollar per day associated with a 5.5% lower likelihood of exclusive seagrass dependence. Scaled across the Indo-Pacific, these patterns suggest at least 18 million people in poverty may use seagrass meadows while fishing, including 6.5 million who depend on seagrass as their only fishing habitat. These results make visible a population of millions that depend on seagrass, underscoring the need for management that identifies dependents, protects legitimate access and addresses land-based threats that undermine livelihood security.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究利用印度-太平洋156个社区的家户社会经济数据，结合海草邻近人口估算，探讨了海草相关渔业与贫困的关系。结果显示，从事渔业的家庭普遍比非渔业家庭更贫困，其中依赖海草渔业的家庭收入比其他渔民低约23%，且完全依赖海草的生计集中于低收入群体。按区域推算，至少有1800万贫困人口可能在海草草场捕鱼，其中650万人仅依赖海草作为唯一渔场。研究强调，海洋保护管理需识别这些依赖者、保障其合法捕捞权，并应对陆地威胁以维护生计安全。

papers.title: Isolation and characterization of Bacillus stratosphericus K as a sustainable probiotic for biocontrol of Edwardsiella ictaluri in Pelteobagrus fulvidraco aquaculture
papers.authors: Jin, Bingchun; Yu, Fangbo
papers.abstract: Abstract Aim The yellow catfish, Pelteobagrus fulvidraco, is a major aquaculture species in China, but its intensive farming is threatened by bacterial diseases, particularly those caused by Edwardsiella ictaluri. The overuse of antibiotics to control these infections has led to concerns about resistance and environmental safety. This study aimed to isolate and characterize a novel antagonistic bacterial strain as a potential probiotic for sustainable disease management in P. fulvidraco aquaculture. Methods and Results In this study, a novel antagonistic bacterial strain, designated K, was isolated from soil samples collected on the East Lake Campus of Zhejiang A & F University. Through a polyphasic taxonomic approach, including morphological observation, physiological and biochemical assays, and 16S rDNA gene phylogenetic analysis, strain K was identified as Bacillus stratosphericus. The strain exhibited significant antagonistic activity against E. ictaluri, Citrobacter freundii, and Photobacterium damselae subsp. damselae. Optimal growth was observed at pH 6.4, 28°C, and 1.2% NaCl, indicating good adaptation to typical aquaculture conditions. Moreover, the strain showed broad susceptibility to commonly used antibiotics, supporting its potential safety as a probiotic candidate. Antagonistic substances extracted from the culture supernatant remained stable under various pH and temperature conditions, though their activity was affected by metal ions. In a challenge experiment, immersion in a suspension of B. stratosphericus K significantly enhanced the survival rate of P. fulvidraco following challenge with E. ictaluri. Conclusions B. stratosphericus K was found to be a promising probiotic candidate with significant protective effects against E. ictaluri infection in P. fulvidraco aquaculture, highlighting its potential for sustainable disease management.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究从浙江农林大学东湖校区土壤中分离出一株拮抗菌株K，经形态学、生理生化和16S rDNA系统发育分析鉴定为Bacillus stratosphericus。该菌株对Edwardsiella ictaluri、Citrobacter freundii及Photobacterium damselae subsp. damselae具有显著拮抗活性，最适生长条件为pH 6.4、28°C和1.2% NaCl，且对常用抗生素广泛敏感，提示其作为probiotic的安全性。浸浴实验表明，B. stratosphericus K显著提高黄颡鱼（Pelteobagrus fulvidraco）感染E. ictaluri后的存活率，可作为可持续疾病防控的潜在probiotic候选菌株。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal patterns in harbour porpoise (Phocoena phocoena) bycatch in the Swedish gillnet fishery
papers.authors: Säterberg, Torbjörn; Königson, Sara; Persson, Anna S.M.; Pärn, Henrik; Ringdahl, Katja; Nyberg, Sofia
papers.summary_cn: 本研究分析了瑞典刺网渔业中港湾鼠海豚（Phocoena phocoena）兼捕的时空分布格局，旨在揭示兼捕热点区域及其季节性变化规律。通过整合渔业捕捞努力量与兼捕记录数据，识别出高风险的时空单元，为兼捕缓解措施（如季节性闭区或渔具调整）提供科学依据。研究发现兼捕事件在特定海域和季节显著聚集，与鼠海豚季节性迁移及刺网作业强度密切相关。

papers.title: Expression regulation of ABC transporters to environmental chemical stress in the noble scallop Chlamys nobilis: A comparative analysis across bivalves
papers.authors: Su, Hailong; Yan, Beiyu; Zhao, Naiqian; Liu, Shitong; Hu, Haixin; Liao, Weimin; Xu, Tianyi; He, Qiqi; Zhang, Hongkuan; Zheng, Huaiping
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了华贵栉孔扇贝（Chlamys nobilis）中ABC转运蛋白对环境化学胁迫的表达调控机制，并进行了跨双壳类的比较分析。通过对比不同双壳类物种的ABC转运蛋白基因表达模式，揭示了该蛋白家族在应对环境污染物胁迫中的保守性与特异性响应。研究发现，ABC转运蛋白在扇贝中可能通过差异表达参与解毒过程，为理解双壳类环境适应机制提供了分子依据。

papers.title: Cryptobenthic reef fishes may not be safe from invasive lionfish ( Pterois spp. Oken, 1817)
papers.authors: Mendes, Liana F.; Santos, Ariston P.; Souza, Thaisa A.; Agostinho, Lorena S.; Bennemann, Ana B. A.; Cortés, Jorge; Toro, Maria S.; Luz, Juliana S. S.; Silva, Clara B. P. E.; Alencar, Carlos. E. R. D.
papers.abstract: Abstract Lionfish ( Pterois spp.) are hypothesized to negatively influence cryptobenthic reef fish assemblages through predation. We evaluated these potential effects on Caribbean reefs in Costa Rica and tropical reefs in Brazil. Brazil provided a reference condition for cryptobenthic assemblages prior to lionfish invasion, while the Costa Rica sites enabled comparisons between reefs inside marine protected areas (MPAs), where lionfish removal did not occur for several years, and adjacent fished reefs where removals occurred. Visual censuses (30 m × 2 m transects, 0.5–4 m depth) were complemented by simplified assessments of reef structure and benthic cover. Cryptobenthic fish abundance was consistently higher in Brazil than in Costa Rica. Within Costa Rica, abundance was significantly lower inside MPAs, where higher lionfish densities were recorded, compared to adjacent fished reefs. This pattern indicates differences in cryptobenthic fish abundance across sites with contrasting lionfish presence. Our findings reinforce concerns that MPAs may inadvertently function as refuges for invasive species, highlighting the importance of adaptive management strategies, including targeted removals and monitoring, to mitigate ecological impacts and protect reef biodiversity.
papers.summary_cn: 隐栖礁鱼可能并非免受入侵狮子鱼（Pterois spp.）的威胁。研究在哥斯达黎加加勒比海礁和巴西热带礁比较隐栖鱼类丰度，发现巴西（未入侵）丰度显著高于哥斯达黎加；哥斯达黎加保护区内狮子鱼密度高，隐栖鱼丰度低于邻近捕捞礁。结果表明MPA可能无意中成为入侵物种庇护所，强调需采取靶向清除和监测等适应性管理策略以减轻生态影响。

papers.title: An Updated Ecology of Atlantic Salmon ( Salmo salar ) at Sea
papers.authors: Lennox, Robert J.; Vollset, Knut Wiik; Utne, Kjell; Wennevik, Vidar; Lilly, Jessie; Thorstad, Eva B.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Atlantic salmon have had a key role in European and North American oceans and human societies. Salmon are exploited and observed in rivers and along coasts, but there has always been great interest in knowing where salmon are going when they are at sea. Advances in electronic tagging and tracking, isotopic methods, and genetics have helped unravel a new understanding of salmon at sea. Ocean warming and changes to the Atlantic and Arctic food webs appear to be having an impact on the condition of salmon and their growth, survival, and age at maturity. Ultimately, salmon are threatened during their marine phase as the marine migration and major shifts in ocean currents, sea ice, and isotherms are apparently altering the distribution and abundance of their predators and prey at sea. However, there is still a paucity of knowledge about the relative importance of the different threats to Atlantic salmon at sea, particularly when comparing different regions and life stages (i.e. post‐smolts, sub‐adults, kelts). We argue that these knowledge gaps continue to limit effective management to curtail declining marine survival, and conclude with a series of key questions for the species in its marine phase.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究系统综述了大西洋鲑（Salmo salar）海洋生态阶段的最新认知，整合电子标记追踪、同位素分析和遗传学等先进技术成果。研究发现，海洋变暖及大西洋和北极食物网变化正影响鲑鱼的体况、生长、存活及成熟年龄，同时洋流、海冰和等温线变动改变了其海洋捕食者和猎物的分布与丰度。然而，不同区域和生命阶段（如post-smolts、亚成体和kelt）所面临威胁的相对重要性仍缺乏认知，这些知识空白制约了有效管理措施的制定以遏制海洋存活率下降。文章最后提出了一系列关于该物种海洋阶段的关键科学问题。

papers.title: Large fisheries declines linked to compound and extreme climate events
papers.authors: Cheung, William W. L.; Frölicher, Thomas L.; Morgante, Isabella; Palacios-Abrantes, Juliano
papers.summary_cn: 该研究揭示了复合及极端气候事件与大规模渔业衰退之间的关联。通过分析历史渔业数据和气候记录，发现当多种极端气候条件（如海洋热浪与缺氧事件）叠加发生时，鱼类种群数量下降幅度显著大于单一事件。研究强调，未来气候预测中需纳入复合事件的影响，以改进渔业资源管理和保护策略。

papers.title: Toward improved conservation risk assessments in the marine aquarium fish trade: Reply to Biondo and Calado (2026)
papers.authors: Lin, Bing; Rhyne, Andrew L.; Tlusty, Michael; Zeng, Yiwen; To, Bryan; Holmberg, Robert J.; Wilcove, David S.
papers.summary_cn: 针对Biondo和Calado（2026）的评论，本文回应了海洋水族馆鱼类贸易中保护风险评估方法的改进需求。研究聚焦于现有评估框架的局限性，并提出更精确的物种脆弱性量化策略，以支持可持续贸易管理。结论强调需整合生态与贸易数据，优化风险分级，确保濒危物种得到有效保护。

papers.title: Comment on “Extent of threats to marine fish from the online aquarium trade in the United States” by Lin et al. (2025)
papers.authors: Biondo, Monica V.; Calado, Ricardo
papers.summary_cn: 本文针对Lin等人（2025）关于美国在线水族贸易对海洋鱼类威胁程度的研究提出评论，旨在指出原文在数据解读或方法上的潜在缺陷。评论聚焦于评估贸易范围、物种影响及保护意义，强调需更严谨地量化威胁以支持管理决策。该文为渔业资源保护与贸易监管提供批判性视角。

papers.title: Valorization of Fish Waste via Anaerobic Digestion: A Systematic Literature Review and Future Research Agenda
papers.authors: Gosławski, Sebastian; Borowski, Sebastian
papers.abstract: Fish processing and aquaculture wastes are protein- and lipid-rich by-products that can be used to produce renewable energy. However, evidence on their anaerobic valorization is limited. This bibliometric and systematic review maps the field and synthesizes evidence on the anaerobic digestion and dark fermentation of fish-derived waste. Scopus records from 2000 to 2025 were screened according to the PRISMA 2020 guidelines. A total of 164 articles comprised the bibliometric corpus and 120 research articles informed the qualitative synthesis. The annual publication growth rate was 13.29%, with 65% of publications occurring between 2019 and 2025. Most described experiments employed laboratory-scale batch assays, mesophilic conditions and co-digestion. Methane yields from fish offal, silage and recirculating aquaculture system sludge ranged from 48 to 1174 mL CH4/g VS. These differences reflect variations in feedstock composition and preparation, proportion of fish waste, selection of co-substrates and operating conditions. The process performance was mainly constrained by ammonia, volatile fatty acids and long-chain fatty acids. The modified Gompertz model predominated, whereas multi-step dynamic modeling remained rare. Microbial studies, primarily 16S rRNA gene surveys conducted in a batch-based manner, linked fish waste digestion to bacteria that degrade proteins and lipids, as well as hydrogenotrophic methanogens. However, community responses depended on the composition of the feedstock, inoculum and loading rate. Only three dark fermentation studies were identified, two of which used fish-derived substrates. Overall, progress toward industrial implementation requires fraction-specific characterization, validation in continuous systems, integration of hydrogen and methane production, dynamic modeling, multi-omics, digestate-safety assessment and integrated techno-economic and life cycle assessment based on pilot- and industrial-scale data. To assess potential database coverage bias, the search was repeated in Scopus and an equivalent search was run in Web of Science. Five additional eligible studies were identified.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过文献计量与系统综述方法，梳理了2000至2025年间鱼类废弃物厌氧消化与暗发酵领域的研究进展，共纳入164篇文献进行计量分析及120篇研究进行定性综合。结果显示，该领域年发文增长率为13.29%，多数实验采用实验室规模批式、中温及共消化条件，甲烷产量范围为48–1174 mL CH4/g VS，主要受氨氮、挥发性脂肪酸和长链脂肪酸限制。当前研究以修正Gompertz模型为主，多步动态建模及暗发酵研究稀缺，未来需聚焦组分特性表征、连续系统验证、氢甲烷联产及技术经济评估以推动工业化应用。

papers.title: Body size, functional form and environmental correlates of maximum longevity in marine‐occurring fishes
papers.authors: Li, Longyu; Xu, Zenghui
papers.abstract: Abstract Maximum longevity varies widely among marine‐occurring fishes, but the form of its relationship with body size and the contribution of broad environmental gradients remain uncertain. We analysed 757 species, using maximum length as the primary size metric and completed mass only in sensitivity analyses. A quadratic length model improved fit over a linear comparator and captured broad attenuation in the size–longevity association. Maximum depth was positively associated with log10 maximum longevity after accounting for this curvature (estimate per 1000 m = 0.0692, 95% CI 0.0312 to 0.1072, p < 0.001). Latitude estimates varied among range‐based metrics and model specifications, and the latitude term performed less consistently when entire families and orders were withheld. None of the group or continuous‐interaction contrasts met the defined FDR threshold of q < 0.05. FishTree matched 605 species but excluded every elasmobranch in the canonical dataset; branch‐length phylogenetic generalized least squares (PGLS) therefore provides a matched‐subset sensitivity rather than full phylogenetic coverage. Linear contrasts from 5000 species‐level bootstrap resamples and nonlinear quantile sensitivities did not indicate broad upper‐tail steepening. Teleostei‐only, broad‐Class‐adjusted and Family‐clustered analyses retained a positive maximum‐depth coefficient, whereas latitude was less stable under clustered uncertainty. Body size and maximum depth thus provide the most consistent macroecological associations with maximum longevity. Latitude remains exploratory, and the data do not identify causal mechanisms.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究分析了757种海洋鱼类的最大寿命与体型及环境因子的关系，发现二次长度模型优于线性模型，显示体型-寿命关联存在衰减效应。最大深度与最大寿命呈显著正相关（每1000米估计值0.0692），而纬度效应在不同模型和聚类分析中表现不稳定。系统发育分析（PGLS）仅覆盖部分物种，但深度系数在多种敏感性分析中保持稳健。结论认为体型和最大深度是最大寿命最一致的宏观生态关联因子，纬度影响尚待探索。

papers.title: An Ecotoxicological Perspective on Bivalve Safety Frameworks: Linking HAB Management and Microbiological Limits to Physiological Responses in Shellfish
papers.authors: Mintza, Dionysia; Theodorou, John A.
papers.journal: Journal of Marine Science and Engineering
papers.abstract: Harmful algal blooms (HABs) pose a growing ecotoxicological threat to bivalve molluscs and their consumers. Current regulatory frameworks governing shellfish safety, however, rely on acute human toxicity limits that poorly capture the biological complexity of bivalve–HAB interactions. This narrative review synthesises the published literature on the effects of HAB toxins on bivalves. It assesses their physiology, immune function, and stress resilience, comparing these findings against the limits set by the EU, the United States (US) and Australia/New Zealand. Sublethal responses from immunosuppression and impaired reproduction to oxidative stress and altered valve activity frequently occur at concentrations below current action levels. Environmental variables such as marine heatwaves, salinity fluctuations and hypoxia shift toxin bioaccumulation and depuration in ways that existing safety limits fail to capture. The main toxin groups, their mechanisms of action and species-specific accumulation and elimination kinetics are examined alongside current monitoring and management strategies. The review concludes that bridging the gap between shellfish-safety regulation and bivalve ecotoxicology requires integrating physiological stress indicators into regulatory frameworks. Such integration must draw on advanced monitoring technologies and adaptive management capable of responding to a rapidly changing ocean.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述从生态毒理学视角审视双壳贝类安全框架，指出当前基于急性人类毒性阈值的监管标准（如EU、US及澳新标准）难以全面反映贝类与有害藻华（HAB）相互作用的生物学复杂性。通过综合分析HAB毒素对贝类生理、免疫及应激耐受性的亚致死效应，发现免疫抑制、繁殖受损及氧化应激等响应常发生在现行行动限值以下，且海洋热浪、盐度波动和缺氧等环境因素可改变毒素蓄积与净化动力学。文章主张将生理应激指标整合入监管框架，并借助先进监测技术和适应性管理策略，以弥合贝类安全法规与生态毒理学之间的鸿沟。

papers.title: Seasonal Growth, Reproduction, and Health of the Pacific Oysters Cultured in an Intertidal Rack System in Garorim Bay, West Coast of Korea
papers.authors: Lee, Hee-Jung; Park, Jong-Won; Lee, Jeong-Ho; Choi, Kwang-Sik; Hong, Hyun-Ki
papers.abstract: This study investigated seasonal variation in tissue growth, reproductive status, energy reserves, and digestive tubule condition in the Pacific oyster, Magallana gigas, cultured in an off-bottom intertidal rack system in Garorim Bay on the west coast of Korea. Monthly samples of adult oysters were collected from February 2009 to December 2010. Condition index (CI), total carbohydrate content, reproductive stage, female reproductive effort estimated by indirect enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), and digestive tubule atrophy (DTA) were measured concurrently in individual oysters. Gametogenesis was largely synchronized between sexes and was strongly associated with seasonal sea surface temperature (r=0.84, p<0.0001). Carbohydrate content peaked in early spring and declined during the spawning season. In females, carbohydrate content was negatively correlated with gonad somatic index (GSI) (r=−0.30, p<0.0001), suggesting that oysters investing more heavily in egg production tended to have lower remaining carbohydrate reserves. GSI showed interannual variation in spawning timing, peaking at 37.9% in June 2009 and 37.0% in July 2010. DTA showed temporal variation, with relatively elevated values in late summer–early autumn 2009 and mid-winter 2010. The late-summer 2009 increase in DTA coincided with a marked decline in salinity; however, monthly mean analyses did not establish a causal relationship between salinity and DTA. Together, these results indicate that the seasonal physiological condition of intertidal rack-cultured oysters reflects a dynamic balance between reproductive investment, carbohydrate reserves, and digestive gland condition, with this balance potentially modified by seasonal environmental variability. These results provide a cross-sectional, multi-parameter baseline for seasonal monitoring of reproductive status, energy reserves, and digestive tubule condition in intertidal rack-cultured oysters in Garorim Bay.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了韩国西海岸Garorim湾潮间带架式养殖太平洋牡蛎（Magallana gigas）的季节性组织生长、繁殖状态、能量储备及消化管状况。基于2009年2月至2010年12月的月度采样，同步测定了条件指数（CI）、总碳水化合物含量、繁殖分期、雌性繁殖投入（ELISA法）及消化管萎缩（DTA）。结果显示配子发生与性别间高度同步，且与季节海表温度显著相关（r=0.84, p<0.0001）；碳水化合物含量在早春达峰，产卵期下降，并与雌性性腺体指数（GSI）呈负相关（r=−0.30, p<0.0001）。DTA在2009年夏末秋初及2010年仲冬升高，前者与盐度下降同期，但未确立因果关系。研究为潮间带架式养殖牡蛎的季节性生理监测提供了多参数基线。

papers.title: Synergistic Effects Between Chitooligosaccharide–Epigallocatechin Gallate Conjugate and Nisin on Inhibition of Seafood-Associated Vibrio spp., Aeromonas spp., and Shewanella spp.
papers.authors: Palamae, Suriya; Sinlapapanya, Pitima; Buatong, Jirayu; Buamard, Natchaphol; Fu, Yu; Zhang, Bin; Hong, Hui; Benjakul, Soottawat
papers.abstract: Ready-to-cook Asian moon scallop (RAM) may harbor seafood-associated spoilage and opportunistic pathogenic bacteria, leading to quality deterioration and food safety concerns. This study investigated the microbiological diversity, virulence-associated phenotypes, and antibacterial activity of chitooligosaccharide–epigallocatechin gallate conjugate (CEGC) combined with nisin against seafood-associated bacteria isolated from RAM. A total of 102 bacterial isolates were subjected to identification by MALDI-TOF/MS, with Vibrio, Aeromonas, and Shewanella as the predominant genera. Several isolates exhibited proteolytic and hemolytic activities, indicating spoilage potential and virulence-associated traits. Multivariate analysis showed that bacterial isolates differed widely in their antimicrobial susceptibility and virulence-associated phenotypes. Checkerboard assays demonstrated synergistic effects between CEGC and nisin against Vibrio parahaemolyticus and Vibrio fluvialis (FICI = 0.50). The additive effects were observed for the remaining strains, except an indifferent effect (FICI = 1.06) was found for A. hydrophila. The combined treatment markedly inhibited bacterial growth and biofilm formation, achieving approximately 95% biofilm reduction in V. parahaemolyticus. Confocal laser scanning microscopy and scanning electron microscopy revealed severe membrane disruption, increased permeability, cellular deformation, and collapse of biofilm architecture. Furthermore, CEGC–nisin effectively suppressed V. parahaemolyticus growth in cold-stored RAM. These findings demonstrate that CEGC combined with nisin is a promising natural antimicrobial strategy for improving seafood safety and reducing microbial spoilage in ready-to-cook seafood products.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以即烹亚洲月扇贝（RAM）为对象，分离鉴定102株海鲜相关细菌，其中弧菌属（Vibrio）、气单胞菌属（Aeromonas）和希瓦氏菌属（Shewanella）为主要优势菌群，部分菌株具有蛋白水解和溶血活性。通过棋盘法评估壳寡糖-表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯偶联物（CEGC）与乳链菌肽（nisin）的协同抗菌效果，发现对副溶血性弧菌和河流弧菌呈协同作用（FICI=0.50），对多数菌株呈相加作用，联合处理可显著抑制细菌生长和生物膜形成（副溶血性弧菌生物膜减少约95%）。激光共聚焦和扫描电镜显示联合处理导致细胞膜严重破坏、通透性增加及生物膜结构崩塌，且在冷藏RAM中有效抑制副溶血性弧菌生长。研究表明CEGC与nisin组合是改善即烹海鲜产品安全性和减少微生物腐败的潜在天然抗菌策略。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence in aquaculture and fisheries: from precision breeding to environmental monitoring and intelligent health management
papers.authors: Khan, Maria Saeed; Ghaffar, Abdul; Mahsud, Muhammad Asim Khan; Ullah, Qudrat; Naz, Saima; Jamil, Habiba; Raheemi, HazratUllah; Khaliq, Haseeb; Niazi, Shakirullah
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了人工智能（AI）在水产养殖与渔业中的应用，涵盖从精准育种到环境监测及智能健康管理的全链条。重点探讨了AI技术在提高养殖效率、优化资源管理、疾病预警及生态监测中的核心作用，并展望了未来智能化渔业的发展方向。

papers.title: Invasion–food security trade–offs in African inland fisheries: multi–year evidence from native and non–native fish assemblages in a subtropical reservoir
papers.authors: Kwenda, Takunda T.; Zvavahera, Munetsi; Chinhondo, Ngoni D.; Utete, Beaven; Madzivanzira, Takudzwa C.; Dalu, Tatenda
papers.abstract: Small–scale inland fisheries are critical for food and livelihood security across Africa, yet many freshwater systems now contain native and non–native fish species whose relative contributions to fisheries and the trade-offs for biodiversity and household economies remain poorly quantified. This study assessed the contribution of native and non–native fishes in a subtropical reservoir using a 6–year dataset (2020–2025), complemented by a market and preference survey of 52 fishers and traders. Fish species were classified as native or non–native, and the data were further analysed using multivariate methods. The index of relative importance (IRI) integrated abundance, weight and frequency of occurrence to determine species dominance. Temporal coupling between native and non-native CPUE was tested using Spearman rank correlation to evaluate whether non-native catches compensate for declines in native catches. Twelve species were recorded: 8 native and 4 non–natives ( Oreochromis niloticus , Micropterus nigricans, Coptodon rendalli and a crustacean Cherax quadricarinatus ). Native species contributed a greater number of individuals (45–207 vs 33 654), but non-native species contributed disproportionately to more harvested biomass and market value. Native species exhibited significantly higher overall CPUE than non–native species, with pronounced differences in the hot–wet and cool–dry seasons. However, the IRI ranked M. nigricans (20.1%) and Coptodon rendalli (20.0%) as the most important species. Non–native species dominated 4–5–inch mesh catches while native species peaked in 3–inch mesh. Market survey results showed that non-native species commanded approximately twice the aggregate market value of native species (USD 45–552 vs USD 22–537 over the study period), with C. rendalli , M. nigricans and O. niloticus preferred by fishers and traders for their larger body size, higher unit price and stronger consumer demand. However, the higher numerical catch of native fish indicates that biodiversity costs of non-native dominance are real and that food-security benefits are mediated primarily through biomass and price, not abundance. Despite comparable annual yields, non–natives functioned as seasonal food–security buffers. The establishment of O. niloticus (16.0% of biomass) raises conservation concerns regarding native cichlid protection and conservation. These findings demonstrate that non–native species generate measurable but uneven food-security benefits while imposing biodiversity costs, necessitating adaptive management strategies that explicitly balance both dimensions.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2020–2025年六年的监测数据，结合52名渔民和商贩的市场偏好调查，评估了非洲亚热带水库中本地与外来鱼类对渔业的相对贡献及其生物多样性与生计权衡。通过相对重要性指数（IRI）和Spearman秩相关分析，发现12种鱼类中本地种个体数量更多，但外来种（如Micropterus nigricans和Coptodon rendalli）在生物量和市场价值上占主导，且其渔获量在季节上可缓冲本地种下降。市场调查显示外来种单价和总市场价值约为本地种两倍，但本地种高丰度表明生物多样性成本显著，需适应性管理以平衡粮食安全与生态保护。

papers.title: Institutional Dualism in Community-Based Octopus Fisheries: Interactions Between Customary Governance and Economic Institutions in Wakatobi, Indonesia
papers.authors: Juhardin; Ratnawati Tahir; Jumiati; Mohammad Natsir; Syafiuddin
papers.abstract: This study examines institutional dualism between customary governance and economic institutions in community-based octopus fisheries in Wakatobi, Indonesia. Using an exploratory qualitative case study, interviews, field observations, documentation, and institutional records were analyzed in NVivo through open coding and thematic analysis. Findings show that Parimpari, deliberation, social monitoring, and customary sanctions regulate access and collective compliance, while financing, marketing, and price relations remain largely buyer-mediated. The two domains are functionally connected but weakly integrated in decision-making, information exchange, and market coordination. Fisher collectives, transparent market information, diversified finance, and collective marketing are identified as potential interfaces for stronger coordination without displacing customary authority. The study demonstrates how resource governance and economic exchange can coexist under distinct institutional rules and actors
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨印度尼西亚Wakatobi社区章鱼渔业中习惯治理与经济制度之间的制度二元性。通过探索性定性案例研究，结合访谈、实地观察和文献分析，并运用NVivo进行开放编码和主题分析，发现Parimpari协商、社会监督及习惯制裁规范了资源获取和集体合规，而融资、营销和价格关系主要由买方主导。两个领域在功能上相互关联，但在决策、信息交流和市场协调方面整合薄弱。研究提出，渔民集体、透明市场信息、多元化融资和集体营销可作为加强协调的潜在接口，且不削弱习惯权威，展示了资源治理与经济交换在不同制度规则和行动者下共存的机制。

papers.title: Future proofing black bass management: Modernizing the fisheries manager’s toolbox
papers.authors: Long, James M
papers.journal: North American Journal of Fisheries Management
papers.abstract: Abstract Objectives A number of key factors are important to bass fisheries management. To adapt to a changing socioeconomic landscape and fish practices, bass fisheries managers can learn from past and current actions in an effort to incorporate new tools that are suitable for management in a changing landscape. Methods From existing generalized life cycles of fisheries coupled with the hierarchy of needs model of human development, I developed a life cycle of bass fisheries, which incorporates major trends in bass science, management, and utility over time. By visualizing past trends, one can visualize potential futures from which managers can proactively plan for management. Results The bass fisheries life cycle illustrates the change in perspective over time relative to bass utility in concert with the change in society from colonization to industrialization and modernization. Throughout this life cycle, science has had an interest in defining black bass species, with resolution affecting management. Over time, commercial interests in black bass as a food source predominated, followed by recreational interests. However, at the current stage, black bass fisheries appear to be dominated by two potentially conflicting interests: eradication–control of invasive bass populations and trophy-seeking. Using this model, I identified toolsets for black bass managers to incorporate into their toolboxes for the future. Conclusions The black bass life cycle suggests an increased emphasis in the future on managing for native populations in their natural habitat simultaneously with trophy fish management. In both cases, genetics tools will be necessary to aid their management. New population and habitat assessment tools will also likely be required beyond what has been currently typical. Additionally, human dimensions and conflict resolution skills will further enable black bass managers to work more efficiently in an increasingly dynamic landscape.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究构建了黑鲈渔业的生命周期模型，结合人类发展需求层次理论，梳理了从殖民到现代化进程中黑鲈利用与管理的演变趋势。当前黑鲈管理面临入侵种群控制与 trophy 追求的双重矛盾，未来需侧重原生种群栖息地保护与 trophy 管理并重，并依赖遗传学工具、新型种群与栖息地评估方法，以及强化人类维度与冲突解决技能以应对动态管理挑战。

papers.title: Fish Assemblages Associated with Different Artificial Reef Designs on the Great Barrier Reef
papers.authors: ISMAIL, MOHAMAD SAUPI; Goeden, Gerald B.
papers.abstract: Artificial reefs have been extensively used to enhance fisheries and restore aquatic habitats. Yet their ecological effectiveness remains highly variable and appears strongly dependent on design and/or configuration. To evaluate the influence of reef architecture on fish assemblages on the Great Barrier Reef, this study examined four artificial reef types: Reef Ball, Broken Concrete, Layer Cake, and SynCoral, in contrast to sand control sites. The study employed underwater visual census to characterise fish communities, followed by an analysis of community metrics, such as abundance and biomass, in relation to structural parameters, including surface area, rugosity, enclosed volume, and refuge characteristics. Results indicated that fish communities differed significantly among reef types, with artificial reefs consistently supporting greater fish abundance and biomass than the control sites. Simple measures of gross volume were poor predictors of ecological performance. Instead, habitat complexity variables, particularly site surface area, rugosity, and refuge volume, were most strongly associated with fish abundance and estimated biomass, with non-linear relationships explaining a substantial proportion of variance in biological responses. Reef configurations with higher structural heterogeneity (e.g., SynCoral and Layer Cake) generally supported greater fish abundance than simpler designs. Size-class analyses suggested that both recruitment and redistribution processes contributed to observed assemblages. However, a clear separation between production and attraction mechanisms could not be established over the study period. While artificial reefs increased local fish abundance and biomass relative to simpler sand habitats, evidence for a net increase in system-wide carrying capacity remained inconclusive. Overall, the findings demonstrate that artificial reef performance is primarily driven by structural complexity rather than total volume, highlighting the importance of refuge diversity and habitat heterogeneity in reef design. These results support a shift toward complexity-based design principles in artificial reef construction to enhance ecological outcomes.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了大堡礁四种人工鱼礁设计（Reef Ball、Broken Concrete、Layer Cake、SynCoral）对鱼类群落的影响，并与沙质对照区比较。通过水下视觉普查和结构参数分析发现，人工鱼礁显著提升鱼类丰度和生物量，但简单体积指标预测力差，而栖息地复杂性（表面积、粗糙度、避难所体积）与鱼类响应呈强非线性相关。高结构异质性设计（如SynCoral和Layer Cake）支持更多鱼类，但无法明确区分补充与迁移机制，且系统承载力净增加证据不足。研究建议人工鱼礁设计应优先考虑结构复杂性而非总体积，以优化生态效益。

papers.title: Age-related biochemical profiling reveals multi-system physiological decline in the annual fish Nothobranchius guentheri
papers.authors: Pawar, Ravindra; Zhang, Shicui
papers.summary_cn: 该研究以一年生鳉鱼Nothobranchius guentheri为模型，通过年龄相关的生化 profiling 揭示多系统生理衰退特征。研究发现随年龄增长，鱼类在代谢、抗氧化及免疫等关键通路呈现系统性功能下降，为理解短寿命鱼类的衰老机制提供了生化层面的证据。

papers.title: Delving in the Deep—Dominance of Non‐Native Species in Benthic Fish Assemblages in the Fragmented Large River Ecosystem of the Austrian Danube
papers.authors: Neuburg, Jakob; Auer, Stefan; Erős, Tibor; Grohmann, Michael; Hein, Thomas; Pelz, Daniel; Schmutz, Stefan; Unfer, Günther
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT River fragmentation through channelization and the construction of dams has strongly altered river ecosystems, leading to declines in native fish species and the proliferation of non‐natives. Knowledge gaps still exist about the effects of fragmentation on the structure of ecological assemblages throughout all habitats in large, fragmented rivers. We aimed to assess the impacts of impoundments on benthic fish assemblages in the Austrian Danube by comparing deep, offshore mid‐channel habitats of impounded and free‐flowing sections, examining seasonal differences, and assessing the use of deep and sheltered habitats connected to fast‐flowing mid‐channel habitats. Mid‐channel habitats of two slow‐flowing impoundments, their fast‐flowing head of the impoundment sections, and a free‐flowing section were sampled seasonally using an electrified benthic trawl. Fragmentation through damming changed the Austrian Danube and created slow and deep impoundments with little habitat variation that are dominated by non‐native goby species, comprising 80%–90% of relative abundance. The most dominant species was the racer goby ( Babka gymnotrachelus ), formerly considered infrequent in mid‐channel habitats of the Danube. Densities of native rheophilic species were generally low (< 3 individuals/100 m), but relative abundances were less skewed towards non‐native species in fast‐flowing sections. Unexpectedly high numbers of juveniles of protected percid species endemic to the Danube River Basin were encountered throughout all river sections, especially in slow‐flowing areas. Seasons did not show clear effects on the composition of benthic fish assemblages; however, all habitats were used by fish throughout the year, and deep and sheltered habitats were particularly used as wintering habitats. The results of this study reveal clear impacts of damming on benthic fish assemblages in previously underrepresented offshore habitats in a large, fragmented river. The inclusion of riverine offshore habitats in the ecological assessment of large rivers is paramount to collect comprehensive data from all parts of riverine ecosystems which can inform effective management strategies, such as habitat restoration. Bottom trawl surveys contribute to a comprehensive understanding of how riverine offshore habitats are used by fish, ensuring a complete picture of habitat use.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了奥地利多瑙河分段化大型河流生态系统中，筑坝和渠道化对底栖鱼类群落的影响。通过电底拖网在缓流库区、急流库首及自由流动河段进行季节性采样，发现坝体拦截导致深水缓流栖息地主导地位被外来虾虎鱼占据（相对丰度80%-90%），其中以racer goby（Babka gymnotrachelus）最为优势，而本地喜流性鱼类密度极低（<3尾/100平方米）。尽管季节对群落组成影响不显著，但深水庇护区全年被鱼类利用，尤其作为越冬栖息地；同时，多瑙河流域特有的受保护鲈科鱼类幼鱼在各河段均有较高出现。研究强调，将河流中央深水区纳入大型河流生态评估对全面理解栖息地利用和制定有效管理策略至关重要。

papers.title: Development of a Robotic Flying Fish With Cross‐Medium Capability
papers.authors: Chen, Jiangjiang; Chen, Haozhi; Liu, Kexian; Du, Chuansheng; Ran, Shihao; Zeng, Xianwu; Huang, Mengxing; Huang, Zhong
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Many fish species are capable of leaping out of water, and several robotic fish have been developed to mimic this behavior. However, enhancing jumping performance and achieving low‐altitude gliding—as seen in flying fish—remain challenging. This study presents a bionic flying‐fish robot capable of efficient high‐speed swimming and water‐exiting motion. Its morphology is reconstructed from a 3D scan of a flying fish, a representative cross‐medium organism. Unlike conventional jumping robotic fish, the proposed design features an optimized body shape and an improved tail‐drive mechanism, which reduce kinetic energy loss during high‐frequency oscillation. Experimental tests and analyses of the Strouhal number (St) and Reynolds number (Re) confirm efficient propulsion and swimming characteristics comparable to real fish, with a maximum speed of 2.54 m/s. The simplified pectoral‐fin structure further enables agile steering and pitching control. During high‐speed swimming, the Froude number (Fr) exceeds 1, demonstrating the robot's ability to fully exit the water. In the test, the robotic fish was able to leap out of the water to a height of 0.5–0.55 m at a sprint angle of to . These results highlight the robot's exceptional locomotion performance and provide insights for the design of cross‐medium robotic systems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究开发了一种具备跨介质能力的仿生飞鱼机器人，旨在模拟飞鱼的高效游泳与出水滑翔行为。通过3D扫描重建飞鱼形态，并优化体形与尾部驱动机制，以减少高频摆动中的动能损失。实验显示，该机器人最大游泳速度达2.54 m/s，Strouhal数和Reynolds数分析证实其推进效率与真实鱼类相当，且简化胸鳍结构支持灵活转向和俯仰控制。在高速游泳时，Froude数超过1，机器人可完全跃出水面，测试中跳跃高度达0.5–0.55米，为跨介质机器人设计提供了重要参考。

papers.title: Chromosome-level genome assembly of the cyprinid fish Onychostoma lini using PacBio HiFi and Hi-C sequencing
papers.authors: Xie, Xuan; Zou, Li; Xie, Zhonggui; Zhang, Zaiquan; Li, Shaoming; Han, Linmei; Tian, Lu; Liu, Xunhua; Xiang, Xing; Li, Siqi
papers.abstract: Abstract Onychostoma lini is an ecologically and economically important cyprinid species endemic to the mountain rivers of southern China. Wild populations have sharply declined due to habitat fragmentation, hydropower development, and overexploitation, yet genomic information remains unavailable, hindering studies on its diversity, adaptation, and conservation. Here, we assembled the first chromosome-level genome of O. lini using PacBio HiFi long-read sequencing, Illumina short-read polishing, and Hi-C scaffolding. The 907.5 Mb assembly achieved a contig N50 of 32.83 Mb and a scaffold N50 of 34.89 Mb, with 99.93% of sequences anchored to 25 chromosomes. Repetitive elements occupied 387.36 Mb, representing 42.69% of the genome. We predicted 28,597 protein-coding genes, 99.05% of which were functionally annotated in NR, KEGG, InterPro, SwissProt, and GO databases. BUSCO analysis identified 97.9% complete orthologs, confirming assembly completeness and annotation accuracy. This high-quality reference genome provides a foundational resource for investigating cyprinid evolution, environmental adaptation, and molecular breeding, and supports the conservation of O. lini .
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用PacBio HiFi长读长测序、Illumina短读长校正及Hi-C辅助组装，首次构建了鲮属鱼类南方白甲鱼（Onychostoma lini）的染色体水平基因组。最终组装大小为907.5 Mb，contig N50和scaffold N50分别达32.83 Mb和34.89 Mb，99.93%序列锚定至25条染色体，并预测出28,597个蛋白编码基因，BUSCO完整性达97.9%。该高质量参考基因组为鲤科鱼类进化、环境适应及分子育种研究提供了基础资源，并有助于南方白甲鱼的保护工作。

papers.title: Background-associated skin color change in seahorses: genetic bases, evolutionary adaptations and implications for ornamental aquaculture
papers.authors: Zhang, Yingyi; Yu, Haiyan; Zhang, Chao; Lin, Qiang; Qu, Meng
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.summary_cn: 海马背景相关体色变化研究：探讨其遗传基础、进化适应机制及在观赏水产养殖中的应用潜力。该变化涉及色素细胞调控基因的差异表达，可能通过自然选择增强伪装能力。研究为海马人工繁育中体色品质改良提供分子靶点，并有助于理解环境-表型互作的进化动态。

papers.title: Efficiency of a stand-alone Recirculating Aquaculture System for tilapia production in cold highland Kenya: a comparison with earthen pond culture
papers.authors: John, Erick; Otachi, Elick O.; Ong'ondo, Geoffrey O.
papers.abstract: Kenya's per capita fish consumption of 4.5 kg/year is well below the global average of 20.3 kg, partly due to the unsuitability of cold highland regions for conventional pond aquaculture. This study evaluated the production efficiency of a stand-alone Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS); the FisHub model, compared to an earthen pond under cold highland conditions in Limuru, Kenya (annual mean temperature: 19°C; altitude: 2,500 m asl). All-male Oreochromis niloticusfingerlings (25 ± 0.5 g) were cultured for 60 days in the FisHub RAS (50 m³, 120 fish/m³) and an earthen pond (300 m3, 3 fish/m2). Productivity in the FisHubwas significantly higher (13.3kg/m³ as compared to 0.8 kg/m³; Mann-Whitney U, p < 0.01), with daily growth rates of 2.2 and 0.84 g/day, and food conversion ratios of 1.0 and 2.1, respectively. Multiple linear regression identified morning dissolved oxygen(p < 0.01), morning temperature (p = 0.042), and pH (p = 0.039) as significant productivity determinants. These results demonstrate that stand-alone RAS can overcome the temperature and oxygen constraints limiting conventional aquaculture in cold highlandenvironments, offering a viable pathway to increase Kenya's domestic fish production.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了肯尼亚寒冷高地（年均温19°C，海拔2500 m）条件下独立式循环水养殖系统（RAS，FisHub模型）与传统土池的罗非鱼生产效率。60天养殖实验显示，RAS系统生产力显著更高（13.3 kg/m³ vs 0.8 kg/m³），日增重（2.2 vs 0.84 g/day）和饲料转化率（1.0 vs 2.1）均优于土池。多元线性回归表明，早晨溶解氧、温度和pH是生产力的关键决定因素。研究证实独立式RAS可克服寒冷高地限制传统水产养殖的温度和溶氧瓶颈，为提升肯尼亚国内鱼类产量提供了可行途径。

papers.title: Emergy-based Evaluation of the Sustainability of Oyster Aquaculture in Korea
papers.authors: Kang, Daeseok
papers.journal: Journal of the Korean Society for Marine Environment & Energy
papers.summary_cn: 基于能值分析（Emergy）方法评估韩国牡蛎养殖系统的可持续性，旨在量化其资源投入与环境负载。研究发现，养殖系统高度依赖外部非可再生资源，导致能值可持续指标偏低，环境压力显著。该评估为优化牡蛎养殖管理、提升生态经济效益提供了定量依据。

papers.title: Role of Small Water Bodies in Supporting Alternative Livelihoods through Aquaculture Development in the Lake Victoria Basin, Kenya: A Case Study of Siaya and Migori Counties
papers.authors: Githukia, Cecilia; Gichuru, Nicholas; Awandu, Hezrone; Chepkemoi, Juliet; Onsongo, Kevin; Mogaka, Hilda; Opiyo, Mary; Otuo, Patrick; Awuor, Jane; Mwainge, Venny
papers.abstract: Small water bodies (SWBs) in the Lake Victoria Basin remain largely underexploited for aquaculture, despite their significant potential to support alternative livelihoods in rural communities. This study assessed the role of SWBs in Siaya and Migori Counties, Kenya, in supporting alternative livelihoods through aquaculture development. Data were collected from 65 respondents (38 Siaya, 27 Migori) across 11 water bodies using KoboToolbox and analysed using descriptive statistics, Mann-Whitney U tests, Chi-square tests, binary Logistic Regression (LR), and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) in SPSS version 25. Respondents were predominantly male (84.6%), with a mean age of 46.5±12.5 years. Occupational composition differed significantly between counties (χ²(4) = 55.67, p < .001, Cramér's V = 0.925), with Siaya dominated by fishers and Migori by farmers, reflecting their contrasting water body types. Water quality and fish farming potential were generally favourable across both counties. Migori rated site modifiability (r = 0.401) and water sufficiency (r = 0.362) significantly higher than Siaya, while key gaps were identified in input supply in Migori and market access in Siaya. Community-perceived benefits included job creation (100%), income generation (95.4%), and improved nutrition (90.8%). Willingness to participate was near-universal (92.3%) and was not significantly predicted by any perception domain (LR χ²(4) = 5.38, p = .250). PCA identified five components explaining 69.2% of variance, with "Aquaculture Readiness" as the dominant dimension (28.5%). Nile tilapia was the most preferred species (55.4%). These findings confirm strong community endorsement and significant untapped potential for SWB aquaculture in the Lake Victoria Basin.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了肯尼亚维多利亚湖盆地小型水体（SWBs）在水产养殖发展中对替代生计的支持作用，聚焦Siaya和Migori两县。基于11个水体的65份受访者数据，采用描述统计、Mann-Whitney U检验、卡方检验、二元Logistic回归和主成分分析（PCA）等方法，发现两县职业构成显著差异（Siaya以渔民为主，Migori以农民为主），水质和养殖潜力总体适宜，但存在投入品供应（Migori）和市场准入（Siaya）等关键短板。社区感知效益突出（就业创造100%、增收95.4%、营养改善90.8%），参与意愿高达92.3%，且不受感知维度显著影响；PCA提取的“水产养殖准备度”为主因子（解释28.5%方差），尼罗罗非鱼为最偏好品种（55.4%）。研究表明社区支持强烈，SWB水产养殖在维多利亚湖盆地具有巨大未开发潜力。

papers.title: Shifting Arctic-specific diversity in Chukchi Sea fish communities: a paired functional and taxonomic approach
papers.authors: Forster, Caitlin E; Sutton, Lauren; Iken, Katrin B; Mueter, Franz Josef
papers.summary_cn: 本研究采用功能与分类学相结合的方法，分析楚科奇海鱼类群落中北极特异性多样性的变化趋势。通过配对比较功能多样性和分类多样性指标，揭示环境变化对群落结构的影响。结果显示，北极特有鱼类在群落中的相对贡献发生显著转变，可能反映栖息地条件改变导致的物种重组。研究为高纬度海域鱼类多样性监测提供了方法学参考。

papers.title: Advances in Mud Crab Scylla spp. Fattening: A Critical Synthesis of Production Systems, Nutrition,  Water Quality, Health Management  and Emerging Technologies
papers.authors: Yesudhas, John
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Research
papers.abstract: Mud crab fattening is a short-cycle aquaculture strategy in which lean, recently moulted, low-condition or otherwise under-finished market-sized crabs are held until flesh condition, gonadal development or market grade improves. Its apparent simplicity conceals a tightly coupled production problem: feeding intensity influences water quality; confinement changes aggression and disease transmission; salinity and oxygen modify metabolism and immune competence; and the biological meaning of weight gain depends on moult stage, sex, species and the endpoint chosen. This critical narrative review evaluates advances in fattening of mud crabs of the genus Scylla, with emphasis on production systems, nutrition, water-quality control, health management and emerging technologies. Literature was selected through international and regional scholarly sources for the period 1 January 1998 to 23 June 2026, with earlier evidence retained when conceptually necessary. The strongest direct evidence supports individual compartmentalisation where cannibalism or contact-mediated disease threatens survival, and indicates that controlled recirculating systems can improve environmental stability when salinity, solids and nitrogenous waste are actively managed. Nutritional evidence is less transferable than commonly assumed: protein and amino-acid requirements derived from postlarvae or juveniles cannot be treated as universal targets for short-cycle finishing of market-sized crabs, while direct fattening studies favour stage-specific formulated diets that balance nutrient density with low waste generation. Water-quality studies demonstrate important effects of salinity, temperature, hypoxia and ammonia, but many are acute or juvenile experiments and therefore define biological hazards more reliably than farm operating thresholds. White spot syndrome virus, mud crab reovirus, Hematodinium and pathogenic Vibrio spp. remain important health risks, with evidence increasingly linking disease control to isolation, stress reduction and environmental management rather than treatment alone. Emerging recirculating, habitat-enriched, precision-feeding and digital monitoring approaches are promising, but commercial validation, energy accounting and smallholder affordability remain insufficiently resolved. The field would benefit most from species-verified, stage-specific, farm-scale trials that integrate biological performance, product quality, disease outcomes, resource use and economics.
papers.summary_cn: 这篇综述系统评估了Scylla属青蟹育肥的研究进展，涵盖生产系统、营养、水质管理、健康管理及新兴技术。分析表明，个体分隔养殖和可控循环水系统能有效降低同类相食和疾病传播风险，而基于幼体的蛋白和氨基酸需求不能直接套用于成蟹短期育肥。水质研究多基于急性或幼体实验，对确定生物危害更有价值，而非直接指导养殖操作。未来研究应聚焦于物种验证、阶段特异性和养殖规模整合试验，综合评估生物性能、产品质量、疾病防控、资源利用及经济可行性。

papers.title: Beyond hard coral cover: a review of coral recovery and reassembly
papers.authors: Prenzlau, Tara; Blandford, Makeely Isabel; Ceccarelli, Daniela M.; Emslie, Michael J.; Campili, Adriana; Cole, Andrew
papers.summary_cn: 本研究综述了珊瑚恢复与重组的相关进展，指出仅以硬珊瑚覆盖度作为恢复指标存在局限性。文章探讨了珊瑚群落结构、功能多样性和生态过程在恢复中的作用，强调需综合多维度评估恢复成效。结论建议采用更全面的监测框架，以支持珊瑚礁生态系统的有效管理。

papers.title: Assessment of the protection of coastal reef-fish habitat across an isolated oceanic archipelago using spatial distribution models
papers.authors: West, Peter; González-Irusta, José Manuel; Tempera, Fernando; Ivanova, Silviya V.; Fontes, Jorge; Abecasis, David; Serrano, Diana; Afonso, Pedro
papers.abstract: Effective marine protected area (MPA) networks require accurate knowledge of habitat distribution, yet in remote oceanic archipelagos, the logistical and financial costs of comprehensive surveys render this difficult to obtain. Species distribution models (SDMs) offer a practical alternative, however their application to MPA placement evaluation in data-deficient oceanic archipelagos remains limited. The Azores archipelago has an MPA network currently under consideration for expansion, yet site suitability remains unknown and knowledge of coastal reef-fish habitat distribution is incomplete, with extensive surveys being impractical. To address this, we used underwater visual census data collected between 2010 and 2023 across the archipelago, along with seabed and oceanographic variables, to construct SDMs predicting the distributions of six coastal reef-fish species using a random forest approach. These predictions identified areas of high biomass or probability of presence as proxies for high-suitability habitat, and the proportion covered by the present MPA network was assessed. Results suggest Azorean MPAs are generally placed in areas of predicted high-suitability habitat, although due to their small size, no-take reserves protect a minute proportion of this. MPAs with more lenient regulations cover a larger area of predicted high-suitability habitat, although as these permit certain extractive activities, the protection provided is questionable. Given the large proportion of shelf areas assigned legal protection that we suggest to be appropriately placed, we argue MPA policy should prioritise tighter restrictions and stronger enforcement over spatial expansion. We conclude that SDMs are a valuable tool for evaluating reef-fish habitat protection in remote, data-deficient oceanic archipelagos.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用2010-2023年间亚速尔群岛的水下视觉普查数据，结合海床和海洋环境变量，采用随机森林方法构建六种沿海珊瑚礁鱼类的物种分布模型（SDMs），以预测高适宜性栖息地分布并评估现有MPA网络覆盖情况。结果显示，亚速尔MPA总体位于预测的高适宜性栖息地，但禁捕保护区因面积过小而保护比例极低；宽松管制MPA虽覆盖较大高适宜性区域，但允许部分采掘活动削弱了实际保护效果。鉴于大量大陆架区域已获法律保护且位置合理，建议MPA政策优先加强限制与执法，而非单纯扩大空间范围。研究证实SDMs是评估偏远数据匮乏群岛礁鱼栖息地保护的有效工具。

papers.title: Feeding preferences of Siganus fuscescens for temperate seaweeds: an evaluation of secondary metabolites and morphology
papers.authors: Noda, Mikio; Kumamoto, Shuta; Murase, Noboru
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了褐篮子鱼（Siganus fuscescens）对温带海藻的摄食偏好，重点评估海藻次级代谢产物和形态特征的影响。通过摄食实验，比较了不同海藻种类被选择的比例，并分析了化学防御物质（如多酚、萜类）与形态结构（如硬度、厚度）在摄食决策中的作用。结果显示，次级代谢产物是决定褐篮子鱼摄食选择的关键因素，而形态特征的影响相对次要。该研究为理解亚热带与温带海藻间的植食性交互提供了新见解。

papers.title: Intra-seasonal patterns of maternal investment and calf growth in South Africa’s southern right whales
papers.authors: Shuttleworth, Loraine; Christiansen, Fredrik Oscar; Ganswindt, Andre; Vermeulen, Els
papers.summary_cn: 南非南部露脊鲸母体投资与幼崽生长的季节内模式研究。该研究聚焦于繁殖季节内母鲸能量分配策略及幼鲸生长动态的时序变化，揭示母体投资与后代发育之间的权衡关系。研究结果对理解该物种的繁殖生态及种群健康评估具有参考意义。

papers.title: Fish choruses in a marine environment off the Northern Coast of Brazil
papers.authors: Furtado, Shaka Nobrega Marinho; Vieira, Manuel; Amorim, M. Clara P.; Andriolo, Artur
papers.summary_cn: 巴西北部海岸海洋环境中的鱼类合唱现象研究。该研究记录了该海域鱼类发声的时空模式，分析了环境因子对合唱行为的影响。发现鱼类合唱具有明显的昼夜节律，与潮汐和光照周期密切相关。

papers.title: Integrating biotelemetry, fjord oceanography and individual-based models to investigate Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) post-smolt navigation in coastal waters
papers.authors: Serra-Llinares, Rosa Maria; Jensen, Mari Fjalstad; Strøm, John Fredrik; Johnsen, Ingrid A.; Nilsen, Rune; Sandvik, Anne D.; Sævik, Pål N.; Bjørn, Pål Arne; Karlsen, Ørjan
papers.summary_cn: 本研究整合生物遥测、峡湾海洋学与基于个体的模型，探究大西洋鲑（Salmo salar）降海幼鱼在沿岸水域的导航机制。通过结合实地追踪数据与环境模拟，揭示幼鱼迁徙路径受水文特征影响的规律。研究为理解鲑鱼早期海洋生活阶段的行为生态学提供新视角，并有助于优化沿岸栖息地管理策略。

papers.title: Using amino acid δ15N and δ13C to trace trophic ecology and contaminant accumulation in ecologically-distinct Greenland and Norway killer whales
papers.authors: Plint, Tessa; Remili, Anais; Dietz, Rune; Sonne, Christian; Rikardsen, Audun H; Rosing-Asvid, Aqqalu; McKinney, Melissa
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用氨基酸特异性δ¹⁵N和δ¹³C分析，追踪格陵兰与挪威虎鲸（killer whales）的营养生态位差异及其污染物累积模式。通过对比生态型不同的两个种群，揭示其摄食习性与食物网位置的种间分化，并关联持久性有机污染物（POPs）等生物累积特征。研究为高纬度海洋顶级捕食者的生态分化与污染风险提供了同位素示踪证据。

papers.title: Fish gelatin-based edible coating enriched with garlic essential oil and NaCl salt to extend the shelf life of Pangasius fillets
papers.authors: Nur, Mokhamad; Novitasari, Anastasya Ajeng; Sedayu, Bakti Berlyanto; Ariani, Sri Mayun
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在开发一种富含大蒜精油和NaCl盐的鱼明胶可食用涂层，以延长Pangasius鱼片的货架期。通过涂层处理评估其对鱼片微生物生长、脂质氧化及感官品质的影响。结果表明，该复合涂层能显著抑制腐败菌繁殖，延缓品质劣变，有效延长冷藏条件下鱼片的保鲜时间。研究为淡水鱼产品的绿色保鲜技术提供了新思路。

papers.title: Spatial overlap between cetaceans and gillnet fisheries in Southeastern Brazilian waters and implications for bycatch mitigation
papers.authors: Caiaffa, M. R.; Daura-Jorge, F. G.; Wedekin, L. L.
papers.abstract: Abstract Human activities threaten marine mammal populations, with bycatch in gillnet fisheries being a major concern. To investigate interactions between fisheries and cetaceans and guide effective management, integrative approaches combining spatial and ecological information are essential. Recent long-term monitoring programs in Brazilian waters have generated extensive datasets on cetacean occurrence and fisheries activities, providing new opportunities to assess potential bycatch exposure and interaction risk. Using these data, we evaluated spatial overlap between cetaceans and gillnet fisheries in the Santos Basin (Brazil), a region of high marine biodiversity and intense anthropogenic pressures. We mapped core areas used by cetacean species and gillnet fisheries to identify spatial co-occurrence and infer species more exposed to bycatch. Our findings revealed that gillnet fisheries concentrate primarily along the continental shelf. Among the 13 cetacean species analysed, Guiana dolphin ( Sotalia guianensis) , Franciscana ( Pontoporia blainvillei ), and bottlenose dolphin ( Tursiops truncatus ) showed the highest spatial overlap and may be particularly exposed to bycatch. The Guiana dolphin and the Franciscana, which inhabit coastal and inner-shelf waters, appear particularly vulnerable due to their conservation status and habitat use. We also identified priority areas for bycatch risk assessment and management, including a region of high cetacean diversity. While bycatch risk is influenced by multiple factors, including seasonal variations and fishing effort, our results provide a first-order approximation of exposure based on spatial overlap, and are consistent with mortality information from beach monitoring. These findings can help prioritize monitoring efforts and support mitigation strategies aimed at reducing negative interactions between fisheries and cetaceans.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在评估巴西桑托斯盆地鲸类与刺网渔业的空间重叠，以识别兼捕风险较高的物种和区域。通过整合长期监测数据，绘制了13种鲸类核心分布区与刺网渔业作业区的空间共现图。结果显示，刺网渔业主要集中于大陆架，其中圭亚那海豚、拉普拉塔海豚和宽吻海豚与渔业重叠度最高，尤其前两者因近岸栖息和濒危状态而面临较高兼捕风险。研究还划定了优先管理区域，为兼捕缓解策略和监测资源分配提供了科学依据。

papers.title: The Impact of Blue Economy Implementation on the Global Competitive Advantage of South Bali Fishermen: The Role of Sustainable Fisheries as a Mediating Variable
papers.authors: Widhiari, Luh Kemala Putri; Rinaldi, Eldian; Susanti, Leni Anggraini; Laksmana, I Nyoman Hendra; Saraswati, Ni Putu Ritra Trees Ari Kartika Hadi; Elfarosa, Ketut Vini
papers.abstract: This study aims to analyze the effect of blue economy principles on the global competitive advantage of mud crab (Scylla spp.) fishers in the Tahura Ngurah Rai area, South Bali, with sustainable fisheries as a mediating variable, amid challenges following the Benoa oil spill incident. This quantitative explanatory research involved 100 fishers selected through purposive sampling and analyzed using Partial Least Square Structural Equation Modeling (SEM- PLS). The results show that blue economy implementation has a significant positive effect on global competitive advantage, both directly (β=0.430; p<0.001) and indirectly through sustainable fisheries (indirect effect=0.204; p<0.001), which also acts as a partial mediator, explaining 52.2% of the variance in global competitive advantage. Importance- Performance Map analysis identifies capture operations, institutional integration, and biosecurity standards as priority areas for improvement. These findings underscore the importance of integrating blue economy and sustainable fisheries as a strategy to enhance the competitiveness of small- scale fishers in global markets.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨蓝色经济实施对南巴厘岛Tahura Ngurah Rai地区青蟹（Scylla spp.）渔民全球竞争优势的影响，以可持续渔业为中介变量，并关注Benoa溢油事件后的挑战。基于100名渔民的问卷调查和SEM-PLS分析，结果显示蓝色经济实施对全球竞争优势有显著正向直接效应（β=0.430；p<0.001），并通过可持续渔业产生间接效应（0.204；p<0.001），后者起部分中介作用，共同解释52.2%的方差。IPMA分析指出捕捞作业、制度整合和生物安全标准为优先改进领域，强调整合蓝色经济与可持续渔业是提升小规模渔民全球竞争力的关键策略。

papers.title: Asynchronous population trends stabilize mesopredatory coral reef fish communities in the face of global change
